account.language.title: Language
account.language.label: Interface language
account.language.help: Your choice applies in every organization you belong to. Your saved data does not change.
auth.login.title: Sign in
auth.login.twoFactor.help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app. If your phone is not with you, you can use one of your recovery codes.
auth.forgot.title: Forgot my password
auth.forgot.sent: If an account is linked to this address, we have sent a password reset link. Check your email; the link is valid for 24 hours.
auth.forgot.help: Enter your sign-in email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.reset.title: Set a new password
auth.reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with your new password.
auth.reset.linkMissing: The password reset link is incomplete. Open the link from your email.
auth.password.rules: At least 10 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol.
auth.invitation.title: Accept the invitation
auth.invitation.intro: {0} has invited you to Modulix. Your account: {1}. Set your password; you will then be signed in directly.
auth.invitation.linkMissing: The invitation link is incomplete. Open the link from your email.
auth.invitation.submit: Set my password and sign in
auth.confirmEmail.title: Email confirmation
auth.confirmEmail.intro: Your account email will change to {0}. When you confirm, all your sessions will be closed.
auth.confirmEmail.done: Your email has changed to {0}. For your security all your sessions have been closed; sign in with your new address.
auth.confirmEmail.linkMissing: The confirmation link is incomplete. Open the link from your email.
